subject: spend cap in Budget (32864fa)
body: Budget now has max_cost_usd (default $25). Paid backends raise BudgetExceeded before a request once it is reached. Two follow-ups in your locked files: (1) research/loop.py _exhausted() checks budget.calls only, so at the cap the v2 loop dies on BudgetExceeded mid-iteration and writes no report; adding 'or self.budget.exhausted()' there makes it stop cleanly. (2) cli.py could expose --max-cost next to --max-calls (Budget(max_cost_usd=args.max_cost)).
